subject: Energy
title: Rooftop and Distributed Solar
description: A 60-second lesson on Rooftop and Distributed Solar.

hook.text: Rooftop solar lets homeowners generate their own electricity—turning every building into a mini power plant.

buildup.text: Net metering allows owners to sell excess power back to the grid—spinning the meter backward.

discovery.text: Distributed solar reduces transmission losses—power is generated where it's used, avoiding long-distance wires.

twist.text: Utilities sometimes resist rooftop solar—it reduces their revenue while they still maintain the grid.

climax.text: Australia leads with rooftop solar on over 30% of homes—sometimes producing more midday power than the grid needs.

punchline.text: Your roof is a power plant—solar makes energy personal.

quiz.question: Which country leads in rooftop solar adoption?
